WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
), mine AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS mine
  FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
  WHERE (d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22) OR (d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22)
  GROUP BY 1,2
), ctl AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctl
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  WHERE r.store_id < 900 AND ((d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22) OR (d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22))
  GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT m.fiscal_year, m.fiscal_week, m.mine, c.ctl, m.mine-c.ctl AS diff
FROM mine m JOIN ctl c USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_week)
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH x AS (
 SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at, s.store_id,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY f.sales_line_id) AS n_id,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no) AS n_rl
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-15' AND DATE '2025-09-21'
)
SELECT sale_date, store_id, COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(CASE WHEN n_id>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dup_id_lines, SUM(CASE WHEN n_rl>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dup_rl_lines,
  SUM(CASE WHEN n_id>1 THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS dup_net, MIN(etl_loaded_at), MAX(etl_loaded_at)
FROM x GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN n_id>1 OR n_rl>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH x AS (
 SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.quantity,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no) AS n_rl
 FROM fact_sales_line f
 WHERE f.sale_date >= DATE '2025-04-28'
)
SELECT 'sales' AS kind, MIN(sale_date) AS d0, MAX(sale_date) AS d1, COUNT(*) AS rows_in_dup_groups, COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id||'-'||line_no) AS groups, SUM(net_amount) AS net_all_copies,
  MIN(etl_loaded_at) AS l0, MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS l1
FROM x WHERE n_rl>1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', MIN(return_date), MAX(return_date), COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id), SUM(refund_net), NULL, NULL
FROM (SELECT r.*, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY sales_line_id, return_date, quantity_returned, product_key) AS n FROM fact_return_line r WHERE return_date >= DATE '2025-04-28') WHERE n>1

WITH dedup AS (
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT f.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) AS rn
        FROM fact_sales_line f
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM dedup f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
by_region AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) AS stores
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22
    GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.stores, ty.net_sales AS ty_net, ly.net_sales AS ly_net, ROUND(100.0*(ty.net_sales/ly.net_sales-1),2) AS growth_pct
FROM by_region ty JOIN by_region ly ON ly.region=ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year='FY2026/27'
ORDER BY ty.net_sales DESC

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 1 AS first_week, 22 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
dedup AS (
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT f.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) AS rn
        FROM fact_sales_line f
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM dedup f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) AS stores
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY 1,2
),
ytd AS (
    SELECT cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales_ytd
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND params.last_week
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ty.net_sales/ly.net_sales DESC) AS rank,
       ty.region, ROUND(100.0*(ty.net_sales/ly.net_sales-1),2) AS lfl_growth_pct,
       ty.net_sales AS lfl_ty, ly.net_sales AS lfl_ly, ty.stores AS lfl_stores,
       ROUND(y.net_sales_ytd,2) AS net_sales_ytd
FROM lfl_sales ty CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region=ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year=params.ly_year
JOIN ytd y ON y.region=ty.region
WHERE ty.fiscal_year=params.ty_year
ORDER BY rank

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.region, s.format, s.open_date, s.close_date, s.is_current, s.valid_from, s.valid_to,
       c.closure_type, c.closure_start_date, c.closure_end_date
FROM dim_store s LEFT JOIN ref_store_closure c ON c.store_id=s.store_id
WHERE s.is_current AND (s.open_date IS NOT NULL OR s.close_date IS NOT NULL OR c.store_id IS NOT NULL OR s.store_id>=900 OR s.region NOT IN ('North','South','East','West','Capital Region'))
ORDER BY s.store_id
